chat_channels_shape.name: chat_channels_shape
chat_channels_shape.value:
(
                ("chat_channels"."type" = 'organization' and "chat_channels"."project_id" is null and "chat_channels"."user_a_id" is null and "chat_channels"."user_b_id" is null)
                or ("chat_channels"."type" = 'project' and "chat_channels"."project_id" is not null and "chat_channels"."user_a_id" is null and "chat_channels"."user_b_id" is null)
                or ("chat_channels"."type" = 'direct' and "chat_channels"."project_id" is null and "chat_channels"."user_a_id" is not null and "chat_channels"."user_b_id" is not null and "chat_channels"."user_a_id" < "chat_channels"."user_b_id")
            )

clients_contact_present.name: clients_contact_present
clients_contact_present.value: "clients"."email" is not null or "clients"."phone" is not null

coupons_valid_range.name: coupons_valid_range
coupons_valid_range.value: "coupons"."valid_from" is null or "coupons"."valid_until" is null or "coupons"."valid_from" <= "coupons"."valid_until"

deliveries_kind_shape.name: deliveries_kind_shape
deliveries_kind_shape.value:
("deliveries"."kind" = 'courier' and "deliveries"."carrier" is null and "deliveries"."tracking_number" is null)
                or ("deliveries"."kind" = 'carrier' and "deliveries"."courier_id" is null and "deliveries"."window_start" is null and "deliveries"."window_end" is null)

deliveries_window_order.name: deliveries_window_order
deliveries_window_order.value: "deliveries"."window_start" is null or "deliveries"."window_end" is null or "deliveries"."window_end" > "deliveries"."window_start"

deliveries_courier_when_assigned.name: deliveries_courier_when_assigned
deliveries_courier_when_assigned.value: "deliveries"."kind" <> 'courier' or "deliveries"."status" not in ('assigned', 'picked_up', 'delivered') or "deliveries"."courier_id" is not null

project_integrations_api_key_shape.name: project_integrations_api_key_shape
project_integrations_api_key_shape.value: ("project_integrations"."api_key_hash" is null) = ("project_integrations"."api_key_prefix" is null) and ("project_integrations"."api_key_hash" is null or "project_integrations"."type" = 'storefront')

project_integrations_provider_shape.name: project_integrations_provider_shape
project_integrations_provider_shape.value: ("project_integrations"."type" = 'payment_provider') = ("project_integrations"."provider" is not null and "project_integrations"."credentials" is not null)

payments_cash_shift_only_register_cash.name: payments_cash_shift_only_register_cash
payments_cash_shift_only_register_cash.value: "payments"."cash_shift_id" is null or ("payments"."method" = 'cash' and "payments"."collected_by_employee_id" is null)

billing_payments_paid_shape.name: billing_payments_paid_shape
billing_payments_paid_shape.value: ("billing_payments"."status" = 'paid') = ("billing_payments"."paid_at" is not null and "billing_payments"."period_end" is not null)
